attributes.description: Nginx access-log traffic (request volume, status codes, URL paths, clients, methods, user agents, protocol versions, bytes served) from logs-nginx.access.otel-*, alongside server connection and request counters from metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*.

embeddableConfig.content:
## Traffic & Capacity

What nginx serves and to whom, from the `nginx.access.otel` logs: request volume and methods, bytes served, URL paths, client addresses, user agents and protocol versions.

**Server capacity** — peak connections, request rate and bandwidth in the selected range, and how connections spread across instances (`nginxreceiver.otel` metrics).

For error rates and latency see Request Health; for connection states and accept/handled counters see Server Internals.

attributes.description: Response body bytes sent to clients.

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Total bytes` = SUM(http.response.body.size)

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Total bytes` = SUM(http.response.body.size) BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Total bytes` = SUM(http.response.body.size)

attributes.description: Open client connections per instance (top 10). An instance carrying far more than its peers is the first to run out of worker connections.

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE state == "active"
| STATS `Active connections` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name
| SORT Time ASC, `Active connections` DESC, host.name ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY Time
